title: Every divergence from the settled rules has a cleanup issue or an accepting note
body:
The 2026-09-28 survey of both crates found places where the code diverges from rules likely to land in the Design and Conventions sections of `CLAUDE.md`. Its reports are in the notes. This issue waits on nail-215254 and nail-166084.

## Proposal

Once both sections are written, check each divergence against the final text. File one cleanup issue per divergence, or one per file where a single sweep fixes several. Note here anything accepted as it is.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Splits found in the 2026-09-28 survey, where two conventions coexist. Counts come from grep. The first side of each is the one Claude would pick. None is decided.

### Naming
1. `profile` against `prf` for `&Profile` parameters, 11 against 6. `profile` appears in `forward.rs:10`, `backward.rs:8`, `posterior.rs:5`, `traceback.rs:6`, `optimal_accuracy.rs:7`, `scoring.rs:223` and `trace.rs:213`. `prf` appears in `cloud_search.rs:65`, `:129`, `:221` and `:284`.
2. `target` against `seq` for `&Sequence` parameters, 8 against 7. The changelog moved `Seed`'s fields to `seq` and `prf`.
3. `profile_idx` against `prf_idx` against `p_idx`, 19, 2 and 4.
4. `target_idx` against `seq_idx`, 7 against 16.
5. `_length` against `_len`, 170 against 148. Public fields use the full word, as in `Profile.length`, `Sequence.length`, `target_length` and `profile_length`. `seq_len` and `prf_len` appear as fields twice each.
6. `forward_*` against `fwd_*`. The full word appears in `forward_time`, `forward_cells`, `forward_score`, `forward_matrix` and the module names. The short form appears in `fwd_tau`, `fwd_lambda`, and the locals `fwd_mx`, `fwd_cld` and `bwd_*`.
7. `p_value` against `pvalue`, 21 against 3. The short form is in `seed_pvalue_threshold` and `forward_pvalue_threshold`.
8. A `_utf8` suffix against a `digital_` prefix. `consensus_seq_bytes_utf8` and `map_posterior_probability_to_bin_byte_utf8` use the suffix, and `Sequence.digital_bytes` at `sequence.rs:40` uses the prefix.
9. Extension traits named `*Ext` in nail against `*Utils`, `*Math` and `*Abuse` in libnail.
10. `valid()` at `row_bounds.rs:95` and `cloud.rs:475` against `is_valid()` at `cloud.rs:155`.

### Errors
11. `bail!` against `return Err(anyhow!())`, about 40 against 1 at `database.rs:500`.
12. `.context()` on an `Option` against `.ok_or(anyhow!())`, many against 1 at libnail's `util.rs:370`.
13. `thiserror` against a hand-written `impl Error`, 4 against 1. The one is `IndexCollisionError` at `database.rs:70-85`.
14. A bare `panic!()` against one with a message, about 12 against 14 in libnail. The bare ones cluster at `profile.rs:1212-1263` and `alphabet.rs:131-168`.
15. `expect("")` with an empty message at `sequence.rs:73`.
16. libnail returns `anyhow` from a library crate. Typed errors appear only in `sequence.rs`.

### Types
17. `derive_builder` in nail, 3 uses, against hand-written builders in libnail, 2.
18. Bools against enums for CLI flags. `args.rs` has 7 bools beside `SeedMode`, namely `only_seed`, `full_dp`, `no_null_two`, `use_accession`, `allow_overwrite`, `ali_to_stdout` and `print_summary_stats`.
19. `usize` state consts at `trace.rs:48-59`, such as `M_STATE = 1`, against the `CoreState` and `BackgroundState` enums in `dp_matrix.rs`.
20. Derived against hand-written `Debug`. 8 core types write it by hand.
21. Traits with one impl. `DefaultAlignStage` is the only `AlignStage`, and `IndexMap<String, Offset>` is the only `IndexInner`, at `database.rs:255`.
22. Typed `Index` keys against a bare `usize`. `ad_start_idx` and `block_offsets` inside the matrices use `usize`.

### Tests
23. A `test_` prefix against bare names, about 25 against 10. The bare ones are the `database.rs` tests such as `one_present`, `two_ambiguous_tail` and `five_absent`.
24. `assert2::assert` at `dp_matrix.rs:1133` and `cloud.rs:1511` against std `assert!`.
25. Tolerances of 1e-3 at `sequence.rs:249`, 1e-5 at `profile.rs:1105` and 1e-9 at `scoring.rs:444`, with no shared constant.
26. `mod tests` in 10 files, against `mod test` at `scoring.rs:373` and `pub mod tests` at `fasta.rs:115`. `seeds.rs:92` has an empty `mod tests {}`.
27. Most tests return `anyhow::Result<()>`. `test_advance_forward`, `test_cloud_relationship` and `test_dp_matrix_flat` return `()`.

### Docs and comments
28. Most doc lines start with a capital. A few start lowercase, such as "a helper function for writing tests involving Clouds" in `cloud.rs`.
29. A trailing period on doc lines, 8% against none.
30. Ad hoc markers inside function bodies, `**NOTE:` at `profile.rs:1051` and `/// From HMMER:` at `profile.rs:1064`.
31. Re-exports in `libnail/src/align/mod.rs:13-27` mix 5 named with 3 globs. `structs/mod.rs` exposes `Profile` by two paths, and `output/mod.rs` re-exports nothing.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Work items from the 2026-09-28 survey. Not conventions; each would be forbidden by a rule the Design section is likely to state. Candidates for their own cleanup issues once the rules are settled.

1. 24 println! in libnail non-test code, not feature-gated: util.rs:47-91 (print helper traits), needleman_wunsch.rs:20,58, dp_matrix.rs:117-133,950-956 (dump methods), cloud.rs:942-960 (ASCII cloud render).
2. Commented-out println! at cloud.rs:536-538 (from commit 837ba60) and sequence.rs:270 (test). Commented-out assertion block at profile.rs:1378-1381. About 4 more lines in dp_matrix.rs, 1 in cloud_stage.rs.
3. 4 todo!() in libnail: alphabet.rs:166-167 (DNA/RNA arms), trace.rs:137, profile.rs:1373 (test).
4. unwrap/expect in parsers and IO where Result is available: mmseqs.rs:438,493 file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap(); p7hmm.rs:61 expect("missing name in p7HMM"); pipeline/mod.rs:134 expect("no prf"); profile.rs:896 expect("NaN encountered"). Top files by unwrap+expect: mmseqs.rs 5, profile.rs 5, p7hmm.rs 4.
5. 5 stats-builder .build().unwrap() sites: align_stage.rs:137,217; cloud_stage.rs:143,173,206.
6. color-backtrace is a normal dependency in nail but dev-only in libnail; strum and strum_macros both declared.
7. libnail/src/structs/mod.rs exposes Profile as both structs::profile::Profile and structs::Profile.
8. 19 TODOs, 5 in dp_matrix.rs (180, 288, 439, 614, 722), others at traceback.rs:30,48, backward.rs:87, profile.rs:634.
9. DatabaseIter yields Option<Result<..>> (database.rs:229), the one place the two styles mix.
10. `unreachable!` bare at seed_stage.rs:213 vs with message at cloud_stage.rs:154.
